issue.title: Fix add-account and restoreSession multi-account session safety
issue.body:
## Summary

Two multi-account hazards:

1. **Add account** — `beginLoginSession` overwrites the global in-memory token (and temp SecureStore) while `ACTIVE_USER_ID` still points at the previous user. `handleAddUserLoginSuccess` starts sync whose failures can be attributed to the wrong user.
2. **Cold restore** — if the active user's token is missing, `restoreSession` silently iterates other known users and `switchActiveUser`s without confirmation.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Adding B can hijack A's in-memory session; restore may silently sign in as a different account.

**Expected:** Adding an account writes that account's durable credentials without changing the active session until the user explicitly switches. Restore must not silently switch accounts (fail closed for missing active creds, or show an account picker).

## Scope

**In scope**
- Add-account path: persist new user credentials without changing `authToken` / `ACTIVE_USER_ID` until explicit switch
- `restoreSession`: remove silent fallback switch (or gate behind multi-account picker UX)
- Tests for active A + add B without switch; restore behavior when active creds missing

**Out of scope**
- Durable first-login persistence mechanics beyond what add-account needs (#291)
- Soft reauth / 401 policy (#292)
- Per-request token in sync loops (#294)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Adding a second account does not change the active user's in-memory token or `ACTIVE_USER_ID` until confirmed switch
- [ ] Cold start with missing active credentials does not silently authenticate as another known user
- [ ] Unit tests cover both behaviors (`authSession.test.ts`, add-user / account switcher tests as needed)
- [ ] Device QA on a multi-account device: add second user, force-stop, cold start → still on previous active account (or clear reauth/picker — not a silent other user)

## Verification / test plan

1. Unit tests for add-account isolation and restore fail-closed / picker
2. Device QA with 2–3 known accounts

## File pointers & approach

1. `src/services/authSession.ts` — `beginLoginSession`, `restoreSession`
2. `App.tsx` — `handleAddUserLoginSuccess`
3. Add-user / account switcher UI hooks
4. `src/services/accountSession.ts` if switch semantics need alignment

## Related series (suggested order)

1. **#291** — Persist auth credentials at login (**P0**)
2. **#292** — Soft reauth / no wipe on 401 (**P0**)
3. **#294** — Per-request auth tokens (**P1**)
4. **#293** — Multi-account session safety (**P1**) — this ticket

## Links

- Project board: [Fluent Mobile Board](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9) — please set Status **Backlog**, Priority **P1** (agent lacked project write permission)
